text: Shows that an edit is saved locally and queued with no network, and that several offline edits to one note collapse into one queued change that keeps its original starting version.
States the sync triggers (reconnect, foreground, every 60 s online) and that each sync uploads before it downloads.
Shows the server detecting conflicts by comparing a change's starting version with the note's current version, with no text merging.
Walks through two phones editing the same note offline: the first upload to arrive wins, the later one becomes a server-created ' (conflict)' note, and both phones end up with both versions.
Explains how a retried upload is kept from applying twice, and how an interrupted download avoids skipping changes.
Shows downloads reading the server change log by sequence number in pages (at most 500 per page, at most 100 changes per upload), and says how the phone tracks its progress.
Says where state lives on the phone (notes with versions, queue, progress) and on the server (notes, versions, change log).
Is a Mermaid sequenceDiagram with short notes before or after it.
